label: Low-frequency gain
subgoals: Combine the drain resistor and output resistance in parallel
Multiply by gm for the gain magnitude

label: Gain at a frequency
subgoals: Compute the pole frequency from the output resistance and load
Form the ratio of the frequency to the pole
Divide the low-frequency gain by the root of one plus that ratio squared

label: The pole frequency
subgoals: Multiply the output resistance by the load capacitance
Invert two pi times that time constant
